title: DOE-02: Waste Disposal Office complex-wide analysis and optimal strategy remain unacquired
publisher: Named U.S. government agencies and the U.S. Government Accountability Office
summary: DOE's April 2026 response, as summarized by GAO, says that complex-wide analysis and an optimal strategy exist, but GAO retains the recommendation as Open. The exact analysis, model, alternatives comparison, and decision basis were not located as separate public records. The custodian and claimed product are named, but the evidence needed to evaluate completeness, tradeoffs, and GAO's remaining concerns is still absent.
key_findings: Target or measured object: April 2026 Waste Disposal Office complex-wide waste inventory, alternatives analysis, optimization model, and optimal-strategy basis.
